session_memory_plan.goal: Let the agent recover relevant work from its own prior LBE sessions without requiring the user to restate project context.
principles: Stable session identity and session hash
Hash meaningful session/turn/event records rather than UI redraws or raw text deltas
Persist decisions, executed actions, validation outcomes, evidence/receipt references, checkpoints and session summaries
Bounded relevance-based recall rather than replaying all history
TUI-local memory may exist only as non-canonical pre-integration cache
Canonical persistence remains owned by LBE runtime

browser_chat_bridge_plan.goal: Allow provider-neutral browser chat surfaces to participate in an LBE-governed session without becoming execution or memory authority.
planned_surface: browser session to LBE session/turn correlation
browser_chat_bridge_plan.hard_boundary: Browser chat may reason and converse, but governed tool execution, authorization, validation, evidence, receipts, completion truth and canonical memory remain LBE-owned. No silent direct-browser execution fallback.
